preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board and the value of K are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= board[i][j] <= n*m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All entries in the board are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M[i][j] <= 100000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All costs in the matrix M are within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output is either the minimum cost or -1 if the task is impossible.
The minimum cost is non-negative or -1 if no valid block exists.

postconditions.expression: if min_cost != -1 then any(all(board[x][y] != -1 for x, y in block) and len(set(board[x][y] for x, y in block)) >= K and sum(M[x][y] for x, y in block) == min_cost for block in connected_blocks)
postconditions.description: If a valid block exists, it contains at least K distinct positive numbers, no -1s, and has the minimum total cost.
